label: Text 1
transcript: Lina's class made an international food day. There were sushi rolls, samosas, falafel wraps, pierogi, tacos, jollof rice, a tray of perfect Spätzle, and two pies — one cherry, one a mystery savoury one with rosemary. Mr. Flint had two of everything, on what he called strict research grounds.
